item.text:
# VFX Reference Dossier — dash_attack

## Candidate 1: Demonic Shield Charge (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Demonic Shield Charge Effect
- primary_url: [Official Path of Exile showcase video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=obUQAgSCbxs)
- secondary_urls: [Official MTX shop page](https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/CultistShieldChargeEffect); [Shield Charge mechanics reference](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Shield_Charge)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: An exact straight-line attack-movement reference: the character braces behind the shield, accelerates along a narrow path, and terminates in a frontal collision burst. The demonic treatment adds a persistent directional trail without obscuring the underlying charge geometry.
- readability_notes: The dark red trail and concentrated arrival burst remain legible at the normal isometric camera. The effect clearly separates travel direction from the larger impact footprint.

## Candidate 2: Shield Charge (Path of Exile 2)
- source_game: Path of Exile 2
- skill_or_mtx_name: Shield Charge
- primary_url: [Focused Shield Charge demonstration and explanation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-jrsw_04QWQ)
- secondary_urls: [Shield Charge animation-phase reference](https://www.poe2wiki.net/wiki/Shield_Charge)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The move exposes the archetype’s phases unusually clearly: shield-raising windup, steerable straight-line rush, and forceful collision/winddown. It is especially useful for studying how body pose and shield silhouette can carry the motion before heavier VFX are added.
- readability_notes: The sustained defensive pose and forward dust wake make direction readable even amid combat. The slower, extended active phase is useful for frame-by-frame study.

## Candidate 3: Blitz (Grim Dawn)
- source_game: Grim Dawn
- skill_or_mtx_name: Blitz
- primary_url: [Physical Blitz Warlord gameplay at 12:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=614Li1N-Tf0&t=769s)
- secondary_urls: [Official Grim Dawn Wiki skill page](https://grimdawn.fandom.com/wiki/Blitz_%28Skill%29)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: Blitz is a compact target-locked charge with an unmistakable linear approach and heavy melee arrival. The footage repeatedly demonstrates the complete move against live packs rather than presenting a single staged cast.
- readability_notes: The character’s rapid displacement is easy to track, and the collision produces a concentrated physical hit cue. The travel effect is restrained, so body motion does much of the communication.

## Candidate 4: Shoulder Charge (Lost Ark)
- source_game: Lost Ark
- skill_or_mtx_name: Shoulder Charge
- primary_url: [Isolated skill showcase at 4:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lYrecr253lY&t=251s)
- secondary_urls: [Shoulder Charge skill record](https://lostarkcodex.com/uo/skill/16060/)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The isolated training-ground presentation cleanly shows the preparatory body lean, short straight-line burst, and contact finish. Its compact range makes it a useful reference for a dash_attack that should feel like a committed melee strike rather than general traversal.
- readability_notes: The uncluttered environment and fixed isometric camera make timing and silhouette easy to inspect. The trail is subordinate to the character, while the terminal hit supplies the strongest accent.

## Candidate 5: Vire’s Might with Volcanic Stride (Grim Dawn)
- source_game: Grim Dawn
- skill_or_mtx_name: Vire’s Might / Volcanic Stride
- primary_url: [Skater Shieldbreaker gameplay at 25:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rtZvCDXY2Zw&t=1520s)
- secondary_urls: [Crate Entertainment build showcase](https://forums.crateentertainment.com/t/1-1-9-3-vires-might-vanquisher-templar-cooldown-cycler-mage-speed-tank-video/110707)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: Vire’s Might repeatedly converts a straight-line body charge into a damaging fire path, demonstrating how the active phase can leave persistent geometry behind it. The arrival punctuation is smaller than Blitz’s, but the directional lane is exceptionally explicit.
- readability_notes: The orange ground trail remains visible after the character has moved, preserving the attack vector for observers. Rapid repeated casts occasionally overlap, so individual impacts are clearest at the start of the gameplay segment.

## Candidate 6: Furious Charge (Diablo III)
- source_game: Diablo III
- skill_or_mtx_name: Furious Charge
- primary_url: [Furious Charge Barbarian rundown and gameplay](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0HvsOpRLqXc)
- secondary_urls: [Official Diablo III skill page](https://eu.diablo3.blizzard.com/en-us/class/barbarian/active/furious-charge)
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: This is a direct exemplar of the archetype: a forceful forward rush that damages and knocks enemies aside along its path. Repeated casts show how a short charge can retain a readable launch, transit streak, and terminal hit at high combat cadence.
- readability_notes: The Barbarian’s large silhouette and enemy knockback make the motion readable even when the VFX trail is brief. Dense Greater Rift combat adds clutter, but repeated usage provides ample clean samples.

## Search log
- Searched Path of Exile shop pages and the verified Path of Exile YouTube channel for Shield Charge and Whirling Blades MTX showcases; found the official Demonic Shield Charge video. Phantasmal and Ice Whirling Blades were verified but rejected because they lack a comparably distinct terminal impact.
- Searched for Deepwater, Burrowing, and Misery Shield Charge standalone official videos; verified their shop records, but did not find independently indexed official YouTube showcases.
- Searched Diablo III’s official game-guide pages for Furious Charge, Dashing Strike, Steed Charge, and Seven-Sided Strike. The current searchable pages provide mechanics and rune text but no usable visual media, so they were retained only as secondary validation.
- Searched Grim Dawn Blitz, Vire’s Might, and Shadow Strike build footage; selected the two guides with explicit gameplay timestamps and repeated full casts.
- Searched Last Epoch official sources for Lunge and Shield Rush footage. The official Lunge-overhaul post embeds a Gfycat animation, but that media URL currently returns a 502 error, so it was excluded.
- Searched Lost Ark official and community showcases for Shoulder Charge and Dash Slash. No dedicated official Shoulder Charge clip was found; the timestamped no-commentary all-skills showcase supplied the cleanest verifiable footage.
